bikes.name: Colnago C64 Frameset
bikes.summary: Limited-edition Colnago frameset in black with yellow trims and accents, size 50S. Very well kept and ready to build up.
description: Limited-edition Colnago frameset with yellow trims and accents. Almost like new, very well kept with minimal signs of use, and ready to build up with no replacements needed.
The frame was previously built with a Shimano Di2 12-speed groupset. The groupset is not included, but we have brand new groupsets available if you would like us to build it up for you.
specs: Limited edition, yellow trims and accents
